0022600115.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-0, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) travel to face the Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0, 3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West), with both teams unbeaten and on two-game winning streaks. Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Toronto lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 115-107 defeat in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026.
